d.ko: The dragons are long gone. The Dragon Hunt Frenzy made sure of it. But Rayleigh, the disciple of the Sword Saint, is still trapped in the past. Memories of the whole village getting turned into stone, Black Dragon, and Pied Piper come to haunt her every night...
d.en: The dragons are long gone. The Dragon Hunt Frenzy made sure of it. But Rayleigh, the disciple of the Sword Saint, is still trapped in the past. Memories of the whole village getting turned into stone, Black Dragon, and Pied Piper come to haunt her every night...
d.zh: 在这个世界中，巨龙已经在人类的狩猎下灭绝了。 但是剑圣的弟子雷莉，仍然深陷在15年前的噩梦之中无法自拔。 「化为石头的村庄」「黑龙」「吹笛男」… 多年以来她一直希望探寻当年事件的真相。
